# PR template

```markdown
## What
<one paragraph: what changes and why>

Refs #N
Closes #N            ← closing keyword lives ONLY here, never in commit messages

## Verification
<exact command(s) + results; link the evidence comment on #N>

## Review
Tier: <T0-T3 + one-line justification (the leader's review-decision record)>

## Scope guard
- [ ] Changes touch only projects/<repo> (no zima-root files unless this IS a zima task)
- [ ] No secrets / personal data in diff
- [ ] Legacy issues untouched (read-only)
```
